Welcome to The Vet Tech Collective — the #1 YouTube home for veterinary technicians, vet tech students, and anyone exploring a future in animal healthcare.

If you’re passionate about animals but overwhelmed by low pay, long hours, burnout, compassion fatigue, or the pressure of VTNE exam prep… you’re in the right place.

This channel combines:

Day-in-the-life vet tech vlogs

VTNE study tips, memory hacks & skill breakdowns

Career guidance, specialty pathways & salary growth

Mental-health support for compassion fatigue & burnout


🎓 Whether you’re preparing for the VTNE, already in the field, or just thinking about becoming a vet tech — this channel gives you the real, unfiltered, supportive insight you’ve been looking for.

💛 More than 70% of vet techs experience burnout. Nearly 90% report compassion fatigue.
This space exists to help you feel seen, supported, and empowered.

🐾 Subscribe and join a growing community redefining what it means to be a veterinary technician today.
